Answer: C
Reason: The CT images demonstrate extensive pneumomediastinum and subcutaneous emphysema tracking into the neck (Figures 1-3), with air visible within the spinal canal. In the absence of direct trauma or esophageal perforation signs, this pattern is characteristic of air dissecting from the mediastinum along fascial planes into the retropharyngeal space and subsequently entering the spinal canal via the cervical neural foramina.
